collection_description: This collection is comprised entirely of photographs dating between 1860 and 2010 and oral history interviews. The photographs are in black-and-white and color, of varying dimensions. The oral histories originate from several projects undertaken by the Upper Midwest Jewish Archives through the years. [Finding Aid available at: http://archives.lib.umn.edu/repositories/15/resources/492]

description: A bird's eye view of people attending the Funtennial which was Hadassah's largest fundraising event. Essentially, Funtennial was a large-scale community carnival, with arcade-type games, a queen contest, door prizes, dancing and booths with food and crafts. Hundreds volunteered for the event, and for a decade between 1949 and 1959, thousands attended. Significant funds were raised, all of which went to Israel projects
